blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While global superpowers hold a huge share of the artificial intelligence (AI) market, the consensus among Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) members is that the region should not merely be a consumer of the technology, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said on Tuesday. In a press briefing after the Philippines concluded its Asean chairmanship, Marcos said member-states had agreed that they should take part in guiding the direction of AI development.
